verdict.rationale: The only SDK-relevant evidence is Stripe's llms.txt, which tells users to check the npm registry when installing Stripe packages. That implies official installable packages exist, alongside a documented Treasury API reference for FinancialAccount objects. The CLI and MCP server are separate tools and don't count as SDKs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and their supported languages, Treasury-specific SDK coverage or code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
Stripe Treasury for Platforms provides users with a container for money called a FinancialAccount that is separate from their Payments balance.
